items.headline: Collegium recommends three High Court Chief Justices for elevation to the Supreme Court
items.text: At its meeting on 28 September 2026, the Supreme Court Collegium recommended elevating Justice Sunita Agarwal (Chief Justice, Gujarat High Court), Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya (Chief Justice, Delhi High Court) and Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh (Chief Justice, Telangana High Court) as Supreme Court judges. The recommendations now go to the Centre for notification.
items.why: If the Centre clears the names, the Supreme Court gains three judges and the Gujarat, Delhi and Telangana High Courts will each need a new Chief Justice.

items.body: Supreme Court of India / Union Government
items.headline: Supreme Court asks Centre to consider rules on minors' social media accounts; Centre says it will examine
items.text: Hearing a petition by Just Rights for Children Alliance, the Supreme Court asked the Union Government to consider framing statutory rules so that social media platforms follow Indian law on contracts with minors, which treats such contracts as void. The Court pointed to age-verification and parental-consent mechanisms rather than a blanket ban, and the Solicitor General told the Court the Centre would examine the matter.
items.why: It could lead to binding government rules on how children under 18 sign up to and use social media platforms in India.
